clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, Scarlet Armbands mark the zealots pressing into Forsaken territory. Executor Arren demands them as proof that the newly risen have struck back.

Scarlet Armbands mark the Scarlet Crusade's followers, from Initiates to fresh converts. The Crusade's red insignia warns newly risen Forsaken in Deathknell that danger waits close by. Crusaders make no distinction between the Scourge's mindless servants and the free-willed subjects of the Dark Lady. To them, every walking corpse must burn. Executor Arren gathers the armbands to confirm that enemy scouts southeast of Deathknell have died and that new Forsaken can defend their fledgling nation.
